blocks.html: Star Buds Medical Weed Dispensary Ardmore

Star Buds in Ardmore is the top medical cannabis dispensary in the Carter County area, providing the best medical marijuana needs here in Ardmore, Oklahoma. Our compassionate and knowledgeable staff is here to help you get exactly what you need at the best possible price, and without pushy or overbearing sales tactics. We are proud to own and operate 7 dispensaries throughout the great state of Oklahoma. Come visit us today and see the Star Buds difference for yourself!

Star Buds Medical Weed Dispensary, Ardmore is proud to serve only the top medical cannabis products to customers in Ardmore, OK, as well as surrounding Carter County areas including Lone Grove, Springer, Marietta, Thackerville, Dickson, Madill, Wilson, Healton, Ringling, Davis, Sulphur, and Wynnwood.
Come Visit Our Medical Marijuana Dispensary in Ardmore, Oklahoma!

Welcome to Star Buds Medical Weed Dispensary Ardmore, the best medical dispensary in Ardmore to provide only the highest quality and award-winning cannabis strains in Oklahoma.

At our core, we shine above the competition by creating a welcoming and truly unique experience within our medical dispensary. We highly encourage you to take your time inside our dispensary and enjoy the ambiance of our clean and friendly cannabis store. Feel free to smell the aroma of every premium cannabis strain, inspect the trichomes on various cannabis flowers. Questions about our top-notch medical cannabis products are always welcome!

Whether you have visited other dispensaries near you before or are brand new to shopping at medical marijuana dispensaries, Star Buds Ardmore has everything you could possibly need. Each budtender is knowledgeable and prepared to provide you with outstanding customer service and expert advice to help you pick out marijuana products specific to your needs. We have the best variety of medical cannabis products in the state, including a wide range of cannabis flower, pre-rolls, concentrates, edibles, tinctures, and smoking accessories.

Above all, we provide each customer with an outstanding and unmatched rewards program. Every customer is eligible to earn reward points that count towards savings on various marijuana products! Stop by our location, or order online, to pick up in-store or curbside anytime Monday through Sunday from 8:00 AM to 12:00 AM and see why Star Buds Medical Weed Dispensary Ardmore shines high above the rest.

What to Know Before You Go…

​

This is my first time visiting Star Buds. What should I bring with me?

All visitors must be at least 18 years of age with a valid Oklahoma Medical Marijuana card and must provide a valid photo ID. We take cash and debit cards, and there is also an ATM inside our dispensary for your convenience.

​

Is your dispensary open late?

We understand that normal operating hours are not always convenient for our consumers with busy lifestyles, which is why our dispensary is open every day from 8:00 AM to 12:00 AM.

Does Star Buds offer any discounts or ways to save on orders?

We run product specials 7 days a week, and our loyalty rewards program offers even more savings. We are happy to provide our MED card holders and veterans with a discount upon request.

​
